chunks: Whoever performs hajj seeking thereby the Face of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, not intending by it ostentation nor reputation, Allah will surely forgive him completely.

key_terms.حَجَّ: performed hajj, the pilgrimage to the Sacred House
key_terms.رِيَاءً: showing off in acts of worship
key_terms.سُمْعَةً: seeking reputation or to be heard of by others
key_terms.وَجْهَ اللَّهِ: the pleasure and sake of Allah alone

ai.seo_question: How does sincerity in hajj lead to Allah's forgiveness?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that hajj attains complete divine forgiveness when it is performed purely for Allah, without riya' or seeking fame among people. It emphasizes sincerity in worship and shows that the spiritual value of hajj depends upon the believer's intention.
